## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run e2e` passes
- [ ] Every new UI string goes through `PotaI18n.t` and its key exists in all 6 languages (en, tr, es, fr, de, ar)
- [ ] Naming policy respected (teams: real city + colours/symbol, no real club names; players: humorous soundalike parodies, no real full names; no real logos, photos, likenesses or copied assets)
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes (include an Arabic/RTL one if layout is affected)
